source.author: verg
source.text: Postquam altum tenuere rates, nec iam amplius ullae apparent terrae, caelum undique et undique pontus, tum mihi caeruleus supra caput astitit imber, noctem hiememque ferens, et inhorruit unda tenebris.
source.text_original: Postquam altum tenuere rates, nec iam amplius ullae / apparent terrae, caelum undique et undique pontus, / tum mihi caeruleus supra caput astitit imber, / noctem hiememque ferens, et inhorruit unda tenebris.
source.text_english: After the ships had held the deep, and no lands now appeared any more, sky on every side and sea on every side, then above my head stood a dark-blue rain-cloud, bringing night and winter, and the wave bristled with darkness.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Postquam me a tuo latere subitus turbo conuoluit, postquam glutino caritatis haerentem inpia distraxit auulsio, tunc mihi caeruleus supra caput astitit imber, tunc maria undique et undique caelum.
reuse.text_original: Postquam me a tuo latere subitus turbo conuoluit, postquam glutino caritatis haerentem inpia distraxit auulsio, tunc mihi caeruleus supra caput astitit imber, tunc maria undique et undique caelum.
reuse.text_english: After a sudden whirlwind hurled me away from your side, after that impious tearing apart dragged me away though I was clinging by the bond of love, then a dark blue rain stood above my head, then seas on every side and sky on every side.
